title: AuditRequest
description: Body of one evidence-consistency audit request, schema 1.1.0. This is the JSON body only. HTTP path, method, and auth are out of scope. label and score are display-only and must not be audited.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Producers must send exactly this value until the contract is bumped.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen id. If present, the response must echo it unchanged. Not a content hash.

transcript.description: Interview turns in order. Evidence spans use this array's index, not turn.id.

assessment.description: Clinician reasoning, split only for display. A single section is valid. Claim spans use this array's index, not section.id.

id.description: Stable id for logs only. The response must not point at this id.

speaker.description: Free text, for example clinician1, patient1, caretaker1, or any custom name. Each distinct string is a distinct speaker. There is no limit on how many.

role.description: Optional coarse class. speaker carries the custom name. Do not invent a role that was not supplied.

text.description: Turn text. May be empty. Character offsets count Unicode code points in this string.

timestamp.description: Shown exactly as supplied. Never inferred. The response must not copy this value.

id.description: Stable id for logs only. Claim spans use the array index, not this id.

label.description: Domain or sub-domain name, for example Inattention. Display and grouping only. Never audited.

score.description: Rater score for this section. Display only. Never audited, never recalculated.

text.description: The clinician's reasoning for this section. Claim character offsets count Unicode code points in this string.
